title: Radar sources configuration
description: Schema for config/sources.json. Each entry in the sources array describes one polled data source.

id.description: Unique identifier for this source. Used as the snapshot filename and as a prefix on event IDs.

type.description: Source type. Determines which detection path runs in detector.js.

adapter.description: Adapter module name. Poller uses this to select the correct fetchSnapshot implementation.

url.description: Primary URL to poll. For price sources this is the CoinGecko API base URL; for release sources this is the GitHub Atom feed URL.

assets.description: (price sources only) List of CoinGecko asset IDs to fetch, e.g. ["bitcoin", "ethereum"].

vsCurrency.description: (price sources only) Quote currency for price comparison, e.g. "usd".

threshold.description: (price sources only) Fractional price-change threshold that triggers an event, e.g. 0.02 for 2%. Overrides the global default.

repo.description: (github-release sources only) GitHub repository in owner/name format, e.g. "nodejs/node".

verification.description: Configuration for the verifier that corroborates detected events.

adapter.description: Verifier adapter name. Selects the verify() implementation in src/verifiers/.

symbol.description: (binance verifier only) Binance trading pair symbol, e.g. "BTCUSDT".

url.description: (binance verifier only) Full Binance ticker URL including query string.

apiUrl.description: (github-rest verifier only) GitHub REST API base URL, e.g. "https://api.github.com".
